notes: Django 3.1.7 on Python 3.9, SQLite, seeded through the ORM (9 boards, 53 topics, 477 posts, 12 sample users; English content because the UI is English). Shown page is the topic list of the 'Django' board (templates/topics.html), unmodified template and CSS. The home page (/) was not used because the project's own home.html references a non-existent field (post.created_at), so the 'Last Post' column renders 'By <user> at' with no date; an alternative shot of it is kept at web/boards-home-alt.png. One change in the run copy only: a context processor supplies users_count so the navbar 'Users = 12' is filled (base.html expects that variable but only the unused 'about' view passes it). The Peralta brand font is loaded from Google Fonts as the template does.
